patch_description: Use three-step movement forecasts to choose between progressing, sidestepping, and waiting. For each visible enemy, calculate the probability of occupying a destination either before or after its movement, including blocked attempts that stay. Combine these hazards across enemies and plan against a distance-to-goal estimate. Allow routes through cells that enemies currently occupy, while forbidding immediate entry, so temporary obstructions do not hide reachable objectives. This targets collision deaths and repeated waiting; improvement requires evaluation.
